A '''tension strut''' was a component attached to the nose cone of a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. The struts allowed the nose cone to swing upwards to allow access to the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] primary [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]].<ref name="SWS" />
